steps.say: The contrapositive of \(P \to Q\) is \(\lnot Q \to \lnot P\), so first negate both parts: not ([[q]]) and not ([[p]]).

The converse is [[converse]] and the inverse is [[inverse]]. Neither is equivalent to the original; they are equivalent to each other, which is why proving one of them proves nothing about the statement asked.
